name: @ourobion/engine-stats
description: ourobion S4/S5 stats-core tests — node-side vectors holding supabase/functions/evaluate-signals/stats.ts to ADR-0002 (robust median/MAD signal, Spearman, Pyper–Peterman N_eff, Benjamini–Hochberg, stability windows). The stats core is dependency-free and Deno-free, so these tests import the function-dir .ts directly via tsx: one source file, no mirror, no drift.
